title_en: WAIC 2026 brings more than 1,100 companies and 3,000 exhibits to Shanghai
title_zh: 2026 世界人工智能大会在上海汇聚 1100 多家企业和 3000 多项展品
summary_en: The official Shanghai event guide reported more than 300 global product debuts and a major focus on robots, AI agents and applications moving into everyday life.
summary_zh: 上海官方活动介绍称，大会包含 300 多项全球首发产品，重点展示机器人、智能体以及人工智能走向现实生活的应用。

title_en: China promotes open-source AI, access and global governance at the Shanghai conference
title_zh: 中国在上海大会上强调开源人工智能、普惠使用与全球治理
summary_en: Reuters reported that China presented open-source AI and international training partnerships as part of a wider strategy on access, safety and governance. The geopolitical framing remains contested.
summary_zh: 路透社报道，中国把开源人工智能和国际培训合作纳入更广泛的普惠、安全与治理战略；相关地缘政治解读仍存在争议。

title_en: Shanghai conference photos highlight robotics and increasingly competitive Chinese open models
title_zh: 上海大会图片展示机器人进展与更具竞争力的中国开源模型
summary_en: The Associated Press highlighted hundreds of humanoid robots and the growing presence of Chinese open-source models. Demonstrations do not by themselves prove reliability or mass-market readiness.
summary_zh: 美联社报道重点呈现数百台人形机器人以及中国开源模型的增长。展会演示本身并不能证明可靠性或大规模商业成熟度。

title_en: SJTU team showcases an AI-assisted adolescent scoliosis assessment system
title_zh: 上海交通大学团队展示人工智能辅助青少年脊柱侧弯评估系统
summary_en: SJTU reported that the VeriSpine system combines wearable sensing and an AI algorithm to support screening and personalized intervention recommendations. The article describes a research achievement, not a general clinical guarantee.
summary_zh: 上海交通大学介绍 VeriSpine 系统如何结合可穿戴传感与人工智能算法，用于筛查和个性化干预建议。该报道介绍研究成果，并不等同于普遍临床保证。

title_en: SJTU launches an AI-enabled low-carbon transformation micro-degree
title_zh: 上海交通大学推出“人工智能赋能低碳转型”微专业
summary_en: The university describes a year-long interdisciplinary program connecting AI with renewable energy, carbon management, circular economy and smart cities through theory, cases and practical projects.
summary_zh: 学校介绍该一年制跨学科项目将人工智能与可再生能源、碳管理、循环经济和智慧城市相结合，并包含理论、案例和实践项目。
